description: The array items, expressing datafield properties.

oneOf.description: The datafield definition for an enumerated type.

enumValueMap.description: List of key/value pairs, to map several (string 'based') enumeration values with its corresponding number values.

oneOf.description: The datafield definition for a numbered type.

unit.description: The (variable) unit of a datafield for a numbered type.

minimum.description: Expresses a minimal value range for a standardized DPT (SHOULD be treated as 'ge'). May be a float or integer, hence this no format is defined.

maximum.description: Expresses a maximal value range for a standardized DPT (SHOULD be treated as 'le'). May be a float or integer, hence this no format is defined.

resolution.description: Expresses a scaling factor to limit a datapoint value to a reasonable technical range, as part of a standardized DPT (integer/float) value (SHOULD be treated as '> 0'. Values larger than unsigned 16 bit makes no practical sense.

integer.description: Expresses with a boolean the number format of a datapoint value as an integer (true) or a float (false).

oneOf.description: The datafield definition for a date/time type.

unit.description: The (fixed) unit of a datafield for a date/time type.

oneOf.description: The datafield definition for a string/char type.

charset.description: Expresses the possible values of the charset scheme.

maxLength.description: Expresses the maximum value length in bytes for a string/char, which is not necessarily the same as the current value length (the maximum is limited to a signed 32 bit).

description.description: Represents the description of a datafield.

value.description: The value of this datafield. The 'value' member needs to be omitted if no value is present.
